# Building AI Systems for Real-World Problems

I am a mechanical engineering graduate transitioning into machine learning and AI engineering. My goal is to build AI systems and applications that solve real-world problems and contribute to the development of practical AI solutions for human needs.

[GitHub](https://github.com/innouguru) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/innocent-uguru-310656334/) · [Download CV](assets/CV.pdf) · [Email](mailto:innouguru@gmail.com)

## About

My background in mechanical engineering has shaped how I approach technical problems: understand the problem, work with the available evidence, build a solution, and evaluate whether it works.

I am now applying that engineering mindset to machine learning and AI, with hands-on experience in machine learning, deep learning, data analysis, model evaluation, and ML deployment.

## Selected Work

### Content Opportunity Scoring

A time-aware machine learning system for identifying content with potential future CTR recovery. The project focused on building a leakage-safe evaluation process and comparing the ML approach against an existing rule-based baseline.

**Result:** 0.80 Precision@50 vs. 0.34 for the rule-based baseline.

[View project →](https://innouguru.github.io/flyrank-internship-ml/)

### Plant-GAI-AI — Plant Disease Classification

A computer-vision system for identifying plant diseases from leaf images. I trained a ResNet-18 model using transfer learning and integrated the trained model into a web application.

**Result:** 88.04% test accuracy across 22 disease classes.

[View project →](https://plant-gai-ai.vercel.app/)

## Currently Building

I am continuing to develop my machine learning and AI engineering skills through hands-on projects, with a focus on building useful systems and understanding the engineering decisions behind them.
